title: Machine learning-based diagnostic prediction of IgA nephropathy: model development and validation study.
summary: original PDF verifies biopsy-reference diagnosis prediction with temporal validation in 1,268 patients; reported held-out metrics support a specific diagnostic result, not clinical deployment. AI role: XGBoost, LightGBM, random forest, neural networks, 1D-CNN and logistic regression. The article appeared in Scientific Reports.
